audit_scope: scan-fw manifests from midnight through the last closed 22:20 UTC capture, inclusive

deterministic_grouping.assignment: sha256(seed + ':' + session_id), sorted within stratum, whole-session roles

leakage_risks: Partition by whole session_id: both receivers, visits, and tracklets stay together.
Keep pre-existing DS2 tracking evidence separate from newly admitted raw-only sessions.
Do not transfer the three explicit geometry bindings to new sessions by radio identity.
Freeze a seed and session-stratified assignment before fitting or association.
Reference coordinates may be used only by a post-seal evaluator, never by inference.
